description: This file defines the ImportNode class in the Twig templating engine, representing an import node in the AST. It handles constructing and compiling import-related template nodes.

classes.name: ImportNode
classes.description: Represents an import node in Twig templates, handling construction with expressions and compilation to PHP code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ImportNode with an expression, a variable, and a line number, handling deprecation warnings for argument passing.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the node into PHP code using the provided Compiler instance, generating code to load a template or reference itself.
